svg.title: P1 Build decks: Decks chooser sheet, drawing before implementation
svg.desc: Illustrative fixture data only. Five states show a 393 by 700 bottom sheet, an 852 by 330 centered body-scrolled sheet, empty and twelve-selected states, and the 999 to 1000 pixel handoff to one 300 pixel chooser rail. No real records, card availability, colours or prices.

g.text: sideboard cards. The intended list stays saved.

svg.text: Only the body scrolls; every eligible choice remains
reachable. No list is capped at 2 or 12 options.

g.text: Choose a whole number from 0 to 3 for Example answer.

svg.text: Shared centered sheet: 560px wide, max 86dvh (284px here). Header + footer stay visible;
156px scrolling body in this illustration. Native numeric fields retain their current limits and error words.
No fixed page/footer overlay covers the focused field. Escape, Back and Close dismiss without reverting choices.
No decks available for this plan.
No eligible choices: one plain empty line.
If choices exist but none is selected, retain the
unchecked list; Show the plan is absent, not disabled.
A plan holds up to 12 decks.
Only unchosen boxes are disabled at the limit.
Chosen rows, versions and recipes remain editable.
Rows 14–17 remain in the same scrolling list.
One chooser tree, two visible homes
• Checkbox / list / recipe change → existing 250ms read-only preview.
• Close / Show the plan only dismiss; selections and pending work stay.
• Redraw → restore the fresh matching control; fallback to a visible heading.
• 999 → 1000: dismiss modal, move chooser to rail, restore visible control focus.
• 1000 → 999: show closed Decks launcher; never auto-open a new modal.
• Decks chooser stays open through choices; existing review sheets still close.
05a / 999 × 420 · closed launcher, chooser lives in sheet
Decks opens the chooser; the page has no duplicate checklist.
Existing plan / shared ticks / completion guards stay authoritative.
No modal or hidden duplicate chooser controls.
Shown: fine pointer. Coarse retains 44px controls.
17 eligible choices are illustrative, not an API count: 1 Usual opponent + 2 Built + 1 Being built + 9 Ideas + 4 Products.
MAX_DECKS / PACK_MAX = 12 bounds selected plan participants only. Error/no-version choices remain filtered as today.
Preserve existing server error/status text and sideboard validation. No added choice filters, request fields, reads or writes.
No authoritative choice colours or shortfall counts exist here: no invented swatches, tint, prices or “9 to buy”.
See packing-chooser.md for exact control labels, focus/history rules and unchanged permission/model boundaries.
Wireframe only · P1 light tokens · Figtree / JetBrains Mono with local Segoe UI / Consolas preview fallback · no real records
